headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.14
summary: Discord Rich Presence is here: log in once and your Discord profile shows what you are doing in the launcher and in Minecraft.

items.text: Discord Rich Presence core: OAuth2 login with auto token refresh and a resilient gateway connection that resumes after drops.
Presence follows the launcher: instances manager, instance content, CurseForge, Xbox friends and profiles, with a toggle and login row in Settings.
Playing Minecraft now shows on Discord too, including the server, world or Realm name when the session starts from a minecraft:// link.
Vietnamese labels for all the new Discord Rich Presence strings.
